title: kiln.assets mod manifest (assets/assets.json), format 1
description: Icons, retextures, resources and content blobs a mod serves (native/services/assets/assets.cpp load_manifest; nlohmann::json, comments allowed, no trailing commas). Paths are relative to the assets/ folder; absolute paths and '..' are refused. Wrong value types stop the whole manifest. Docs: docs/kiln/services/assets.md.

format.description: 1 (not checked by Kiln today; keep it for later readers).

guid.description: A resource GUID in .NET Guid text form (the bytes of Guid.ToByteArray() = the game's resource-id order).

file.x-kiln-message: a path relative to assets/ (subfolders allowed; no absolute path, no '..')

type.description: A qualified reflection name (keen::UiTextureResource), hashed FNV-1a-32, or "0x<hash>".

then.description: A PNG icon for an item, keyed by the item's GUID (client only; skipped on a dedicated server).
then.x-kiln-unknownKeysMessage: unknown key in an icon entry (ignored)

then.description: Retexture: a PNG re-encoded to a vanilla texture's own format (client only).
then.x-kiln-unknownKeysMessage: unknown key in a texture entry (ignored)

then.description: A new resource or an override of a vanilla one's bytes (both sides where the game loads the type).

side.description: client: load on clients only (a dedicated server skips the entry and counts it as for clients only).

mode.description: override: the key must exist in the game; new: it must not; omitted: either.
mode.x-kiln-message: mode is "override" or "new" (anything else is read as either)

patch.description: Writes a referenced blob's 16-byte ContentHash at offset in the resource bytes before serving.

then.x-kiln-unknownKeysMessage: unknown key in a resource entry (ignored)

then.description: Content blob bytes: a new blob (hash from the bytes), or with "hash" an override of that game blob (the file length must equal the hash's size).

side.description: client: load on clients only (a dedicated server skips the entry and counts it as for clients only).

then.x-kiln-unknownKeysMessage: unknown key in a blob entry (ignored)
